'''Blanked:''' The Players Committee blanked the Virtual Defensive Shield versions of Wipe Them Out, All Of Them; the rules forum listed the blanking on 30 April 2013 among errata already released (the earlier announcement is not preserved). A blanked card is treated as if it did not exist from that date (in effect a ban); it is not a new version. It stays in its set and is legal in period formats that end before the blanking.
